outOfScope: Graph databases, Graphiti, Cognee, vector stores, temporal or incremental graph persistence.
Symbol-level, call-graph, dynamic import(), package-name specifier or model-inferred edges.
Planner optimization, progressive resolution, adaptive budgeting and Oracle profile acceptance (later continuations).
Changing the delivered createContextGraphProvider seam, SourceCatalog, RetrievalPlanner or ContextRequirement contract.
Adopting the graph in Backend/QA production context (BB-089 and later).
constraints: Additive: one new Oracle module, one index export line, tests and one Living Doc.
Graphs are built only from exact repository blobs at an exact snapshot and from committed CONTEXT_GRAPH_EDGES_V1 files at the same snapshot.
The graph query is a source constraint (graph ref), never providerId/tool/operation fields in ContextRequirement (BB-061 D16).
Research consumes the BB-087 fixed-facade desired state; the Worker binds only DONE BB-087.
No new runtime dependency; Node built-ins only.
invariants: Every edge and every returned path carries AUTHORITATIVE_SOURCE provenance bound to the exact snapshot and file digest; no edge exists without it.
The same snapshot and inputs always produce the same graphId, edge order and traversal output.
CURRENT graph evidence is consumable only when the graph snapshot equals the authoritative repository snapshot; otherwise it fails closed as STALE or CURRENTNESS_UNVERIFIABLE.
Traversal is bounded by hops, items and bytes; exceeding a bound truncates deterministically and reports BUDGET_EXHAUSTED rather than expanding.
architectureDecisions: D1 — Add packages/oracle/src/context-graph.js exporting buildContextGraph, createAuthoritativeGraphClient, parseContextGraphRef and CONTEXT_GRAPH_EDGES_V1; export them from packages/oracle/src/index.js. No other Oracle source file changes.

D2 — buildContextGraph({snapshotReader, repositoryRef, snapshotRef, roots, edgeFiles=[]}) where snapshotReader exposes listFiles({repositoryRef, revision, roots}) and readFile({repositoryRef, revision, path}) -> {content, sourceRef}. It reads only the exact snapshot; working-tree or mutable reads are not possible through this interface.

D3 — Extraction: static relative ES-module edges from `import ... from './x'` and `export ... from './x'` in .js/.mjs files under roots, normalized with posix path joins. Targets inside roots are FILE nodes; targets outside roots are EXTERNAL_BOUNDARY nodes (the probe found 16 such edges into packages/core-harness), never dropped silently. dynamic import() and bare package specifiers are excluded and listed in graph.limits.

D4 — Declared edges: an edge file must parse as CONTEXT_GRAPH_EDGES_V1 {kind, version, edges:[{from, to, relation}]} with relation from a closed set; each declared edge's provenance is the edge file@snapshot plus its digest. Malformed edge files fail the build.

D5 — Identity: node {id, kind FILE|EXTERNAL_BOUNDARY, contentDigest|null}; edge {from, to, relation IMPORTS|REEXPORTS|DECLARED:<relation>, provenance:{kind:AUTHORITATIVE_SOURCE, ref:`${path}@${snapshotRef}`, digest}}; edges sorted by from,to,relation; graphId = sha256(canonical({snapshotRef, roots, edgeFiles, nodes, edges})). The executed probe built 60 nodes / 158 edges twice with an identical digest.

D6 — Graph query ref grammar parsed by parseContextGraphRef: `context-graph://<repositoryRef>/<IMPORTS|IMPORTED_BY>/<hops 1|2>/<anchorPath>`. An unknown relation, hops outside 1..2, or an anchor absent from the graph yields a typed ProviderFailure MISSING or UNSUPPORTED, never a best-effort match.

D7 — createAuthoritativeGraphClient({snapshotReader, repositoryRef, roots, edgeFiles, currentSnapshot}) implements graphClient.traverse({source, need, maxItems}) for the delivered createContextGraphProvider: EXACT uses source.snapshot.ref; CURRENT uses currentSnapshot(); it builds (or reuses an in-memory graph keyed by graphId) and returns {snapshotRef, validators:[{kind:REVISION, value:snapshotRef, strength:STRONG},{kind:CONTENT_DIGEST, value:graphId, strength:STRONG}], paths}. The semantic `need` text is not parsed.

D8 — Paths: breadth-first from the anchor over the requested relation up to hops, ordered by (distance, node id); each path content is canonical JSON of its edge list; provenance lists each edge's AUTHORITATIVE_SOURCE entry. At most maxItems paths are returned; when more exist the client returns the first maxItems and marks truncated:true in path content, and byte limits remain enforced by the delivered planner reservation.

D9 — Currentness wiring: composition registers a CONTEXT_GRAPH snapshot authority whose observe() returns the authoritative repository snapshot for the graph's repositoryRef. The delivered SourceCatalog then rejects a graph built at a different snapshot as STALE and a missing authority as CURRENTNESS_UNVERIFIABLE; the graph never self-certifies CURRENT.

D10 — Evidence basis: BB-062 experiment A (typed graph arm Recall@3 1.000, MRR 1.000 on Q1–Q4) and experiment B (399 vs 48,983 bytes) justify typed authoritative edges; BB-062 D9/D14 reject a graph database for this stage. The BB-088 probe shows a reverse-import projection of 1,939 bytes versus 53,407 raw bytes of the importing files. These are structural feasibility results, not quality or cost claims.

D11 — Worker-start: BB-087 DONE with delivery receipt; confirm createContextGraphProvider, createSourceCatalog and the fixed facade are unchanged package-root exports; mismatch => PLAN_INPUT_CONTRADICTION.
implementationSlices: G1 — Extraction + identity [CG1, INV-1, INV-2]: implement buildContextGraph per D2-D5 with fixture snapshot readers; unit tests for import/re-export parsing, boundary nodes, declared edge files, exclusions and deterministic graphId.
G2 — Query + traversal [CG2, INV-4]: implement parseContextGraphRef and bounded BFS per D6 and D8; unit tests for both relations, hops 1/2, ordering, maxItems truncation and typed failures.

G3 — Client + currentness [CG3, INV-3]: implement createAuthoritativeGraphClient per D7 and composition wiring per D9; boundary test resolves CONTEXT_GRAPH evidence through createContextGraphProvider + createSourceCatalog + createRetrievalPlanner + fixed facade, including stale snapshot and missing authority.

G4 — Real snapshot proof + Living truth [CG4]: boundary test builds the graph from this repository at `git rev-parse HEAD` through a git-backed snapshotReader defined in the test, asserts determinism and AUTHORITATIVE_SOURCE provenance on every edge; add docs/living/system/oracle/context-graph.md and the index export; run Oracle and repository regressions.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: buildContextGraph reads only the exact snapshot, extracts static relative import/re-export and declared CONTEXT_GRAPH_EDGES_V1 edges, represents out-of-root targets as EXTERNAL_BOUNDARY nodes, attaches AUTHORITATIVE_SOURCE provenance with file digest to every edge and yields a deterministic graphId.
evidenceRequired: Unit tests for parsing, boundary nodes, declared edges, malformed edge file rejection, exclusions and repeated-build digest equality.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Graph refs parse only the D6 grammar; traversal is breadth-first, deterministically ordered, bounded by hops and maxItems with explicit truncation, and unknown relation, invalid hops or absent anchor produce typed ProviderFailure without best-effort matching.

Through the delivered provider seam, catalog, planner and fixed facade, CONTEXT_GRAPH evidence resolves COMPLETE with REVISION and CONTENT_DIGEST strong validators; a graph at a non-authoritative snapshot is STALE and a missing authority is CURRENTNESS_UNVERIFIABLE, both non-consumable when REQUIRED.
evidenceRequired: Boundary test logs for positive, stale and missing-authority cases.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: A graph built from this repository's exact HEAD snapshot is deterministic and fully provenanced, only authorized files change, no graph database or new dependency is introduced, and the Oracle context-graph Living Doc documents delivered scope and limits.
evidenceRequired: Real-snapshot boundary test output, Oracle regression and repository verify logs, Living Doc diff.

negativeVerificationCases: A snapshotReader call with a revision other than the requested exact snapshot, or any working-tree read, fails the build test.
An edge without AUTHORITATIVE_SOURCE provenance, snapshot-qualified ref or file digest fails validation.
An import target outside roots becomes an EXTERNAL_BOUNDARY node; silently dropping it fails the test.
dynamic import() and bare package specifiers produce no edge and appear in graph.limits.
A malformed CONTEXT_GRAPH_EDGES_V1 file or unknown declared relation fails the build.
Building twice from the same inputs yields a different graphId or edge order: test failure.
A graph ref with unknown relation, hops 0 or 3, or an absent anchor yields a typed ProviderFailure, never a fuzzy match.
More reachable paths than maxItems returns exactly maxItems in deterministic order with truncated:true.
CURRENT evidence resolved against a graph built at an older snapshot is STALE; a composition without a CONTEXT_GRAPH authority is CURRENTNESS_UNVERIFIABLE; REQUIRED evidence then yields UNSATISFIED.
Introducing a graph database, vector store or new package dependency, or editing provider seam/contract/facade files, fails repository scope verification.
